metadata.identity: N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet Yi Sang
metadata.time_convention: Zero-based native decoded frame; seconds=frame/24; intervals end-exclusive. Input brief says 30 fps, but ffprobe counted 1035 frames at 24/1. No invented 30 fps frames.
metadata.method: Whole-video 6 fps overview, all native frames 300–836 viewed on 23 sheets, enlarged S1 contact sheet. Kit supplied locally; old notes consulted only after frame inspection.
metadata.measurement_limits: Body-height distances are screen-space estimates, not world measurements. Hex colors are visual palette approximations. Skill names are inferred: no skill-name/coin UI. Contact means first visible impact evidence; hidden contact is explicitly qualified.

name: Punch Through

weapon.parts: Long straight narrow barrel, rectangular receiver/fore-end, angular shoulder stock and dark grip; metallic parallel rails/highlights. No sword blade or bayonet can be established.
weapon.holding: Black-gloved grip; shooting stance has stock at shoulder and barrel level right. Close-up f527 shows a supporting glove under the fore-end, so do not prescribe exclusively one-handed firing.
